correctness.rationale: PASS: The greedy two-pattern subsequence-progress DFA product for P=0^a1^b,Q=1^b0^a has four exact disjoint reachable regions D0-D3; the simultaneous split (a,b) is unreachable. Counting gives R=n(n+3)/2+ab. Threshold suffix probes recover both progress coordinates for intersection, showing all R reachable states distinguishable; for union exactly n+1 absorbing accepted states merge and no others, giving R-n=n(n+1)/2+ab. Independent full BFS and partition refinement for all 81 pairs a,b=1..9 confirmed both formulas. Universal result rests on reachability witnesses and threshold proofs, not finite enumeration.

evidence: Brzozowski-Jiraskova-Li Theorem 14 gives generic bounds intersection <=(n+1)^2 and union <=(n+1)^2-2n, for component complexity n+1.
Submitted exact counts R=n(n+3)/2+ab and R-n depend on a,b and are strictly sharper; no equality follows from the generic maxima.
